status: predeclared; final evaluation not yet run
purpose: Broaden the adaptive policy's training distribution and evaluate cost-aware sensing under severe and capability-shifted scenarios.

candidate_training.initialization: Explicit transfer of frozen adaptive-v1 weights; new optimizer and independent policy RNG, not fresh training from scratch.
candidate_training.checkpoint_selection: Maximum equally weighted mean return across normal, stress and capability validation profiles; no final-test access.

candidate_selection.criterion: Maximum equally weighted mean return across the three common validation profiles; ties retain the earlier run seed.

interpretation.success: All threats gain timely confirmed detection in the synthetic simulator; not physical interception or validated field reliability.
interpretation.do_not_censor: All generated scenarios, including unaffordable and physically unobservable cases, remain in reports.
interpretation.capability_generalization: Varied synthetic catalogue parameters and offered sites; not proof of calibration on real hardware.
interpretation.old_final_tests: The published adaptive-v1 final suites informed this next experiment and must not be called independent evidence for robust-v2.
interpretation.changes: Any later protocol change must be recorded before opening the reserved final suites; exploratory or failed runs must be disclosed.
